lyrics:
[Intro: lilting electric guitar figure in harmony, bass, light drums]

[Verse 1: warm, raspy, quick]
Down by the reservoir, shoes in the grass
A bottle of pop and a bus pass
Skipping every stone we found
Sun going down, sun going down

[Chorus: band lifts, tambourine]
Hey, Freckles, you and me
Halfway up the cherry tree
Hey, Freckles
I can still hear the two of us go
La-la, la-la-dee-dah
La-la, la-la-dee-dah

[Verse 2: warm, a little faster]
Behind the bandstand, sharing a coat
You wrote your name on my hand, and I wrote
Mine on yours, and it wouldn't come clean
We were ten, or we might have been thirteen

[Chorus: band lifts, tambourine]
Hey, Freckles, you and me
Halfway up the cherry tree
Hey, Freckles
I can still hear the two of us go
La-la, la-la-dee-dah
La-la, la-la-dee-dah

[Bass Break: bass plays the melody alone, then guitar answers]

[Verse 3: slower start, then picking up]
Now I'm sixty-eight and the tree's a stump
The reservoir's a car park with a speed bump
But a kid went by with a nose like yours
All dots, and I was back outdoors

[Final Chorus: full band, backing voices on the syllables]
Hey, Freckles, you and me
Halfway up the cherry tree
Hey, Freckles
I can still hear the two of us go
La-la, la-la-dee-dah
La-la, la-la-dee-dah

[Outro: guitar figure, syllables, fade]
La-la, la-la-dee-dah
